text_block_list.text:
"Gather data until the Hopeful Stakes"— 
True to his word, Air Shakur collected all 
sorts of data day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!
(Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Major! We're taking your measurements 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Triceps surae up 1.2 cm, gastrocnemius 
unchanged...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We'll measure again every five minutes. 
After that, once you return to your 
original size, we'll pump you up one more 
time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once I reshape it, I'll measure the 
difference in size again in five minutes. 
Be ready.
And other times—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—And this tab shows my vitals linked to my 
gadgets. You can see the numbers in real 
time.

What Air Shakur installed on my smartphone 
was a measurement app she developed 
herself. What catches my eye is its 
bizarrely flashy design.
choice_data_list: Did Shakur design this one too?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You got a problem with that?
choice_data_list:
Maybe a color that's a bit easier on the 
eyes...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up. UI isn't my specialty.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Her times are consistently high-level. 
Next, I'll gather detailed cornering data 
to find a way to shave off even more 
time."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Read out the numbers on the display after 
every single run. I'll adapt my approach 
on the fly based on that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just read the numbers out in order. Don't 
go tryin' anything clever.

Data collection is proceeding smoothly. 
Preparations are progressing as we 
approach the theoretical values needed to 
become a Double Crown Umamusume. However—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's not a millimeter of give in that 7 
cm. Stop goofing off and put your head to 
work, too.

"Conclusive data to positively steer the 
future has not yet been found."

Data that could be useful to her, who 
gathers data so thoroughly. If such a 
thing really exists...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Uncertain things like emotions have lousy 
cost-performance when converted directly 
into data.

If it's merely a lack of 
cost-effectiveness... Couldn't it become 
usable data if I were to shoulder the cost 
myself?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, hello!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, Narita Top Road, reporting in!

Narita Top Road... One generation above 
Air Shakur, she's the high-profile 
Umamusume who won this year's Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You had such a serious look on your face. 
Is something troubling you, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, won't you tell me about it? 
I might be able to help!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Wait a moment, Top Road-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I know exactly what that Trainer is going 
through!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! He was simply captivated by ME, 
the embodiment of beauty—TM Opera O!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! She is completely captivated by 
none other than me—the very embodiment of 
beauty, T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I see~...! As expected of you, Opera 
O-san...!

This year's Satsuki Sho winner, T.M. Opera 
O. And Air Shakur's roommate, Meisho 
Doto... They're one generation above as 
well.

Having experienced numerous races before 
Air Shakur's fresh debut, knowing the 
sheer intensity, the bitter tastes and the 
sweet triumphs—
choice_data_list: You know what racing is all about.
You all know what racing is about

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! That goes for anyone who steps 
onto the Twinkle Series stage.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of cou—rse... hm? What are you talking 
about?

"If I can hear their accounts full of 
uncertain variables and compile it into 
data...!"
choice_data_list: I'd like to hear about it, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah... Still not enough data?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Her conditioning is coming along nicely. 
The stat gains match the simulation. 
However...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(This is as far as it goes. I can't see 
any vision of things getting better from 
here...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(However, even knowing that, all I can do 
now is move forward. Even if hell awaits 
at the end of the road...)
"Let's change destiny."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I don't need any tagalongs.

The next day, when I called Air Shakur 
over, she gladly showed up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it.
choice_data_list:
I've gathered data on the uncertain 
factors.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"'How to Turn the Expectations of Others 
into Strength'... Narita Top Road?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Having people cheer for me... That means 
the world to me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to everyone's 
expectations. I absolutely cannot let them 
down...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking about that lets me hold my 
ground even in tough spots! Their 
expectations give me the power to take 
that very last step forward."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I felt especially grateful for that 
during the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan
text_block_list.text:
――Aah, the Kikuka Sho, right! I saw her 
crying at the Derby after all, so...

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan
text_block_list.text:
I got so carried away cheering myself! I 
screamed so much my throat went hoarse.

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan
text_block_list.text:
I think everyone around felt the same way, 
right? Because they had high hopes that 
she could win... or rather, they wanted 
her to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Even in that focused state during the 
race, everyone's cheers still reached me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That gave me strength... Right before the 
goal, my heart was pounding, they were 
closing in, and honestly, it was really 
tough, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Everyone's cheering was the push I needed!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If it hadn't been for those cheers... who 
knows, I might not have been able to hang 
on until the end.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"—'I analyzed all the races she ran in, 
plugging lap time trends and running 
habits into a comparative formula. And 
then...'"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Just before the finish line of the Kikuka 
Sho—where she said 'their voices pushed my 
back'—her speed had slightly increased 
compared to other races."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"From the above, it can be concluded that 
Narita Top Road channeling the fans' 
cheers into power was a key factor in her 
Kikuka Sho victory."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "...So. What kinda data is this?"
choice_data_list: Just thought it might be helpful.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's useless. It only works on this one, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
True, under certain specific conditions, 
results that defy calculations can indeed 
occur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, d'ya really think cheering me on is 
gonna boost my abilities?
choice_data_list: Still, Shakur might have that too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's not logical...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Shakur! Guess what—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: You have an idea, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Anything that can't be expressed as a 
formula is nothing more than margin of 
error.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“Uncertain factors don't just mean 
throwin' in whatever the hell you want.”
choice_data_list:
Maybe that's where we'll find our 
breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
However, the cost-performance ratio isn't 
worth considering... I told you that 
before, didn't I?
choice_data_list: Still, they actually gathered them all up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Are you saying you'll keep going out of 
your way to ask around and spend time 
putting it all together for me from now 
on, too?
choice_data_list: I want that incorporated into the data.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't see how that's gonna change 
anything.
choice_data_list: Still, it might make a 0.01 cm difference.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

Among the rounded-down figures that don't 
show up on the other side of the equals 
sign, some things might have changed 
leading up to today.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What a bunch of sophistry. Even if the gap 
narrows, there's no guarantee it'll reach 
zero.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Still... you're right. You're right..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'll keep the data in mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I take it that's the conclusion... you 
arrived at after thinking it through.
